vectors.description: Historical baseline reproduced the Phase 1 constructor mismatch: 80 tests executed, 16 errors.
Initial reconciliation with main ran 119 tests and exposed unresolved export guards plus draft/wire API mismatches: 3 failures and 2 errors.
All 122 combined contract and ingestion tests passed, retaining both integration suites and three new cross-builder regressions.
The broader upgrade suite passed 467 tests with 22 declared skips; strict types, lint, formatting, syntax, boundary and context checks passed. Runtime receipt and provider inputs remain unavailable.
